core_obligations: Apply the degreewise result (proof lines 7948-7964): the companion lemma gives the identification of the colimits of the higher direct images of each term of the complexes with the higher direct images of the colimit term.

Compare the first pages (proof lines 7965-7968): the bounded below hypothesis makes only finitely many terms contribute to a fixed cohomological degree, uniformly in the index, so the identification of the first pages of the two spectral sequences is legitimate.
Conclude (proof lines 7968-7972): the comparison of the abutments is the displayed formula.
proof_roadmap: Apply the degreewise relative colimit lemma to each term of the complexes.
Use boundedness below to make the termwise comparison finite in each degree.
Conclude by comparing the abutments of the two spectral sequences.
difficulty_reason: The lemma extends the degreewise compatibility of higher direct images with filtered colimits to bounded below complexes of abelian sheaves along the inverse systems of the companion lemma (statement lines 7930-7945). The proof repeats the spectral sequence comparison: the companion degreewise result is applied to the terms (proof lines 7948-7964), the two spectral sequences of a complex under the direct image functor are displayed, and boundedness below provides the index-independent finiteness that makes the first page comparison valid (proof lines 7965-7968), after which the abutments are compared (proof lines 7968-7972). The non-formal content is the same finiteness bookkeeping as in the absolute case. The claim is H2: a spectral sequence comparison whose finiteness input is stated.
